luna.identity_reason: The preprint title and seven-author list match the linked article metadata, and its adult Iranian case-control population and plant-based diet–NAFLD research question corroborate the link; this is the Europe PMC-linked 2022 preprint, not peer-reviewed journal full text.
luna.reason: The study compares case-control NAFLD status and reports no separable incident NAFLD outcome, so it does not meet the requested incidence endpoint.
unresolved_fields: No incident NAFLD events or incident-risk analysis are reported.

gemini.identity_reason: The Europe PMC-linked preprint (DOI: 10.21203/rs.3.rs-1613519/v1) matches the published article (PMID 38777462, DOI: 10.1016/j.clnesp.2024.04.013) by title ('The association between score of plant-based diet and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in adults'), authors (Fallah A, abdolazimi H, Darabi Z, Talenezhad N, Mirzavandi F, Rahimpour S, Hosseinzadeh M), study design, population (240 adults in Yazd, Iran), and research question.
gemini.reason: This original case-control study evaluates the association between plant-based diet index (PDI) scores and ultrasound-diagnosed NAFLD, reporting fully adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals and meeting JBI criteria with a Good appraisal grade.
